notes.title: Update on the Steam Achievement Fix - June 20, 2025
notes.notes: This update fixes an issue that prevented Steam achievements from displaying or unlocking correctly. The achievement system should now be working as intended for all players. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Devlog #1: The Core Gameplay Loop is Here & Steam Integration is Live!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Early Access players![/p][p]Welcome to the very first developer log for "MugenRPG"! Starting this week, I'll be sharing regular updates on the project's progress in these weekly reports.[/p][p]This week marked a major milestone. After a long, caffeine-fueled overnight sprint, the project has made a huge leap from a "concept" to a "playable core." So, let's dive into the details of this update.[/p][p][b]This Week's Core Progress[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Visual & UI Overhaul:[/b] We've implemented a brand-new, high-quality player character model and designed a unique "Terminal Log" style mission selection interface.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Core Gameplay Loop Activated:[/b] The first high-difficulty "Challenge Mission" is now live! Successfully completing it rewards you with rare resources to unlock powerful weapons, including the Gatling Gun. The full "Challenge-Reward-Enhance" loop is now complete![/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Integration:[/b] The game now fully supports Steam Cloud saves and Achievements. Your progress is safe and sound![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Next Week's Plan[/b][/p][p]Next week, our focus will shift to building out "Chapter 2," which will include new environments, enemies, and boss mechanics. Look forward to more details in the next devlog![/p][p]Lastly, I want to give a special thank you to all the Early Access players who have supported "MugenRPG" from this early stage. Your trust is more valuable than any reward points to a solo developer.[/p][p]Thank you for reading. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to leave a comment below.[/p][p]Best,[/p][p]不老之泉水[/p]
